title: WPPIL/178/2016 of Shamshad Ahmad Vs State Of Uttarakhand AND OTHERS

paras.text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND AT NAINITAL
Writ Petition (PIL) No.178 of 2016
Shamshad Ahmad .....Petitioner
 Versus
State of Uttarakhand & Others .......Respondents
Mr. S.K. Mandal, Advocate for the petitioner.
Mr. B.D. Kandpal, Deputy Advocate General for the State of Uttarakhand/
respondent nos.1, 3 & 5 to 11.
Mr. Naresh Pant, Advocate for respondent no.2.
Mr. Vipul Sharma, Advocate for respondent no.4.
Dated: 17.12.2016
Coram: Hon'ble V.K. Bist, J.
 Hon'ble Alok Singh, J.
V.K. Bist, J. (Oral)
 Petitioner has approached this Court seeking
the following reliefs:-
"i) Issue a writ, order or direction in the
nature of mandamus directing and
commanding the respondents to remove
all the Advertisement Board/Hoardings/
Uni-pole, situated within 55 ft. from the
National Highway No.74 and 87 installed
within the territory limit of District
Udham Singh Nagar.
ii) Issue a writ, order or direction in
the nature of mandamus directing and
commanding the respondents not to
permit any person, authority, institution,
firm, unit and factory for install the
Advertisement Board/Hoardings, within
55 ft. of National Highway No.74 and 87,
within the territory of Uttarakhand."
2. Petitioner claims himself to be a public
spirited person and has no personal interest in the
matter.

2
3. It was found by the Government that
sometimes, hoardings/boards fixed at National
Highways, State Highways, Roads, Link Roads, not only
create inconvenience to the people; but, these hoardings
become the cause of accident also. Therefore, the State
of Uttarakhand issued Gazette Notification on
27.11.2010 in the Official Gazette, providing byelaws for
the Zila Panchayat, Udham Singh Nagar, wherein, it put
some conditions in the byelaws for putting
hoardings/boards etc. Relevant clauses of the said
byelaws are being referred hereinunder:
"3. Any person/institution will neither
affix the board, nor dig the pit in the rural
area of District Udham Singh Nagar on the
roadside of unmetalled road and metalled
road, public places, developed towns and
markets for the purpose of trade/business
without obtaining prior permission of the Zila
Panchayat Udham Singh Nagar. Board affixed
without obtaining prior permission will be
removed by the Zila Panchayat and will be
kept in its possession. Expenses to be
incurred in removing or affixing/placing will
be recovered from the concerned
person/institution.
4. For the convenience, safety of the
general public and for the convenience of the
traffic, the distance of hoardings/boards etc.
from the roadside is determined as under:-
(a) any person, institution, firm, unit,
factory etc. for the propaganda of
advertisement/ hoarding publicity
company will affix, in such a manner, at
55 ft. from the mid of National Highway
or State Highway, so that any type of
traffic and marching will not get affected.
(b) Boards/hoardings will be affixed
leaving aside 20 ft. from the outer corner
of link road or any other metalled road. .

3
(c) The boards will be affixed leaving
aside 10 ft. from the corner of the
unmetalled road.
(d) In case of lesser width of the road
from the distance mentioned in the
above points, the boards will be affixed at
the end of the road.
5. Affixation of the board will be done
by the wooden pole or guarder of iron in such
a way so that it will not get removed by strong
wind.
6. Keeping in view the comfort and
security of the community, the size of the
board, keeping in mind the width of the road,
shall not be more than 15ft. In order to affix
the board larger than this, the permission
letter (licence) will be issued by the licensing
officer, only after the inquiry report of the
Inquiry Officer.
7. Ink/ paint used in the writing of the
board will be prohibited, on whose reflection
driving of the vehicles in the night gets
affected.
8. Writing of vulgar language on any
board/hoarding will be completely prohibited.
9. Nude photograph of female or male
or half nude photograph on the advertisement
board, which can be noticed by the general
public, will be completely prohibited.
10. The Upper Mukhya Adhikari,
Executing Officer and Taxation Officer and
any other authorized employee of Zila
Panchayat Udham Singh Nagar will be
authorized to stop the affixation/writing work
in the mid of it, if violation of any Section of
the Byelaws is found."
4. It is the case of the petitioner that many
hoardings have been affixed on the National Highway No.
74 in violation of the aforesaid byelaws. The petitioner
and other residents wrote many letters to the District
Magistrate, Udham Singh Nagar, Project Director of the
National Highway No. 74, Sub Divisional Magistrate,
Udham Singh Nagar, Sub Divisional Officer, Khatima,

4
Sub Divisional Officer Sitarganj, Sub Divisional Officer,
Kichha, Sub Divisional Officer, Rudrapur, Sub Divisional
Officer, Gadarpur, Sub Divisional Officer, Bazpur and
Sub Divisional Officer, Kashipur. On 21.09.2015, the
District Magistrate, Udham Singh Nagar (respondent no.
3) wrote a letter to the Project Director, National Highway
Authority, Green Park, Rudrapur, Executive Engineer,
National Highway, Public Works Department, Haldwani
and Executive Engineer, Public Works Department,
Haldwani asking them to ensure that illegal hoardings/
boards be removed. Copy of the said letter was also sent
to all the Sub Divisional Magistrates, Udham Singh
Nagar and Senior Superintendent of Police, Udham
Singh Nagar for necessary action, but, nothing was
done. Thereafter, the petitioner wrote to the
Commissioner, Kumaon Mandal, Nainital and Executive
Engineer, Public Works Department, Udham Singh
Nagar; but, all in vain. Mr. Ashok Kumar, Project
Director, National Highways Authority of India also wrote
to the S.D.M., Bazpur, S.D.M. Gadarpur, S.D.M. Kichha,
S.D.M. Rudrapur, S.D.M. Sitarganj, S.D.M., Khatima
and S.D.M. Tanakpur informing them the actual number
of illegal hoardings affixed in the area. By the said letter,
he requested that some date may be fixed in order to
remove the illegal hoardings; but, no action was taken by
the concerned Sub Divisional Magistrates.
5. Lastly, petitioner wrote to the Secretary,
Panchayati Raj, Government of Uttarakhand informing
him about the illegal hoardings and requested him to
take proper action in the matter. Ultimately, the present
Public Interest Litigation is filed.

5
6. On 09.12.2016 and 13.12.2016, learned
State Counsel sought time for seeking instructions in the
matter. Today, Mr. B.D. Kandpal, learned Deputy
Advocate General for the State, on instructions, would
submit that, in fact, at many places, illegal
hoardings/boards have been affixed by many business
organizations from units, factories etc. in violation of the
prevalent byelaws and even prior permission has not
been obtained from the competent authority. Mr. Naresh
Pant, learned counsel appearing for the National
Highway Authority of India and Mr. Vipul Sharma,
learned counsel appearing for the Zila Panchayat,
Rudrapur also fairly submitted that whatever has been
said by Mr. Kandpal is correct. Learned counsel for the
respondents agreed that positive direction may be issued
to the respondents for taking steps in order to remove
illegal hoardings/boards on the National Highways, State
Highways, Roads, Link Roads and inside the local limits
of the Zila Panchayat, Rudrapur also.
7. We have perused the byelaws of the Zila
Panchayat, Udham Singh Nagar and have also
considered the submissions of learned counsel for the
parties. It is admitted to all that hoardings/boards have
been affixed on the National Highways, State Highways,
Roads, Link Roads for advertisement in violation of the
prevalent byelaws. It is also admitted to the parties that
many hoardings are affixed on the National Highways,
State Highways, Roads, Link Roads without prior
permission of the competent authority.
8. In such circumstances, we dispose of the writ
petition in the following manner:

6
(i) First of all the respondents will make
identification of all such illegal hoardings/
advertisement boards/Uni-pole situated in the
National Highway Nos. 74 and 87, State
Highways, Roads, Link Roads, which are
within the territory of District Udham Singh
Nagar.
(ii) Thereafter, further steps will be taken by
the respondents for the removal of such illegal
hoardings/boards from the National
Highways, State Highways, Roads, Link Roads
in District Udham Singh Nagar.
(iii) Entire exercise shall be done on or before
28.02.2017.
(iv) In the meantime, pending application
filed seeking permission for putting
hoardings/boards etc. shall be decided. Fresh
application shall also be entertained and
decided.
(v) The District Magistrate, Udham Singh
Nagar will ensure that the order passed by
this Court is complied with in letter and spirit.
He will issue necessary instructions to all
concerned in this regard.
(vi) All concerned Sub Divisional Magistrates
are directed to cooperate with the National
Highway Authority of India as well as with
other authorities in demarcating the illegal
hoardings/boards from the National
Highways, State Highways, Roads, Link Roads
and also in getting them removed.

7
(vii) The Senior Superintendent of Police,
Udham Singh Nagar is also directed to provide
necessary help, in case need arises.
(viii) After removal of such hoardings/boards
all the concerned officers will also ensure that
illegal hoardings/boards are not affixed again.
(ix) The Registry of this Court is directed to
send a copy of this judgment to all the party
respondents immediately for making its
compliance.
